subtitle: Cross-check of 01/Oct/2026: Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT, the two national polls released on 01/Oct, Datafolha BR-08039/2026 and Real Time Big Data BR-09503/2026, the three from 30/Sep, Futura/100% Cidades BR-01122/2026, Ideia BR-08706/2026 and Indexa BR-00698/2026, and the press flow of 30/Sep and 01/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 37.50% (vol USD 13.00M cumulative) in the winner contract, down 2.00pp raw and 1.73pp normalized, confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 4.65pp, to 28.25% (vol USD 1.20M). POLL: 42% to 38% in the first round and 48% to 45% in the second in Datafolha of 01/Oct; he leads the first round in four of the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct and the second in three.
fortes: Leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct: 42% to 38% in Datafolha, 43% to 39% in Real Time Big Data, 39% to 34% in Indexa and 39.4% to 38.4% in Ideia.

In Datafolha of 01/Oct he rises from 40% to 42% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and from 47% to 48% in the second against the 24/Sep round, and wins the other four pairings tested: 48% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 47% to 42% against Augusto Cury, 49% to 40% against Romeu Zema and 48% to 39% against Renan Santos.
Leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in three of the five: 48% to 45% in Datafolha, 43% to 42% in Indexa and 48.5% to 48% in Ideia.
fracos: Falls 2.00pp in the winner contract, to 37.50%, and the gap widens from 20.30pp to 23.55pp, the fifth straight widening between confirmed readings. Normalized by the pair's sum, which fell from 99.30 to 98.55, the loss is 1.73pp.
In the series recorded since April 14 his price is 30.00pp from the high, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 3.00pp from the low, 34.50% on 25/Apr.

Trails in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Real Time Big Data, by 45% to 46%, and in Futura, by 43.5% to 49%, the only distance outside the margin among the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct.
In Futura he also loses to Ronaldo Caiado, by 42.4% to 45.6%, and to Augusto Cury, by 42% to 45.1%.

📺 Lula announced he will not attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, and on the afternoon of the same day Justice Estela Aranha, of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), issued an injunction barring the broadcaster from showing his empty podium and from directing questions to the absent candidate, and sent the case to the TSE full court (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo).
candidates.analise: Lula fell 2.00pp in the winner contract, to 37.50% (vol USD 13.00M cumulative), in the confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT, and 1.73pp normalized, because the pair's sum fell from 99.30 to 98.55; with that the gap widens from 20.30pp to 23.55pp, the fifth straight widening between confirmed readings. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 4.65pp, to 28.25%. 🗳️ In the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct he leads the first round in four and trails in Futura, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) he leads in three and trails in Real Time Big Data and Futura. Datafolha, which is the chart's benchmark, puts him 4 points ahead in the first round and 3 in the second. 📺 He announced he will not attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 61.05% (vol USD 12.79M cumulative) in the winner contract, up 1.25pp raw and 1.73pp normalized, confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 5.00pp, to 71.50% (vol USD 1.42M). POLL: 38% in the first round and 45% in the second in Datafolha of 01/Oct; he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in two of the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct.
fortes: Rises 1.25pp in the winner contract, to 61.05%, and the gap widens from 20.30pp to 23.55pp, the fifth straight widening between confirmed readings.
In the points recorded on 01/Oct his price ranged from 61.05% to 63.30%, and that 63.30% is the high of the series recorded since April 14.
In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 5.00pp, to 71.50%: the market pays less for the chance that he finishes the first round in second place.
Leads both rounds in Futura of 30/Sep, 42.2% to 39.4% and 49% to 43.5%, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Real Time Big Data of 01/Oct, 46% to 45%.

⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep the second-round vote transfer from the other names favours him: 81% of Romeu Zema's voters, 48% of Renan Santos's, 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's and 34% of Augusto Cury's would go to him (O Globo).
fracos: Trails in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct, with the widest distance in Indexa, 34% to 39%.
In Datafolha of 01/Oct he is 3 points behind in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), 45% to 48%, within the 2pp margin.

⚖️ On the night of 30/Sep the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) full court upheld the removal of the posts that attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro a plan to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint, and released the post by comedian Antonio Tabet and the cases of reasonable doubt, after André Mendonça adjusted his vote (Gazeta do Povo and G1).

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.

cruzamento: Five national polls came out on 30/Sep and 01/Oct and Lula leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four, while the winner contract widened the gap for the fifth straight confirmed reading. 🗳️ On 01/Oct, Datafolha (BR-08039/2026, n=2,506, fieldwork from 28/Sep to 01/Oct) gives Lula 42% to 38% in the first round and 48% to 45% in the second, and Real Time Big Data (BR-09503/2026, n=2,000, fieldwork from 26 to 30/Sep) gives Lula 43% to 39% in the first and Flávio Bolsonaro 46% to 45% in the second. On 30/Sep came Futura/100% Cidades (BR-01122/2026, n=2,000), with Flávio Bolsonaro 42.2% to 39.4% in the first round and 49% to 43.5% in the second, Ideia for Canal Meio (BR-08706/2026, n=2,000), with Lula 39.4% to 38.4% and 48.5% to 48%, and Indexa for Broadcast (BR-00698/2026, n=2,000), with Lula 39% to 34% and 43% to 42%. In the five national polls released on 30/Sep and 01/Oct, Lula leads the first round in four (Datafolha, Real Time Big Data, Indexa and Ideia) and trails in one (Futura), and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) he leads in three (Datafolha, Indexa and Ideia) and trails in two (Real Time Big Data and Futura); only Futura falls outside the margin in the second round. 🏷️ On the night of 30/Sep Veritá released the consolidation of 27 state polls, with 40.5 thousand interviews from 20 to 25/Sep, in valid votes only: Flávio Bolsonaro 45.14% and Lula 44.65%. It does not enter the panel's poll chart because it measures valid votes, not total voting intention, and because each state has its own [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration, with no single national registration. 💹 In the confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 1.25pp, to 61.05%, and Lula falls 2.00pp, to 37.50%, with 1.73pp for each side normalized, and the gap widens from 20.30pp to 23.55pp, the fifth straight widening between confirmed readings. 🥉 In the third-place book of the first round Renan Santos stays ahead, 48.50% to Augusto Cury's 36.70%. 📰 In the news flow, on the night of 30/Sep the TSE full court upheld the removal of the posts that attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro a plan to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint, and released the post by comedian Antonio Tabet and the cases of reasonable doubt, after André Mendonça adjusted his vote (Gazeta do Povo and G1), and on 01/Oct Flávio Dino declared the case moot and closed his action at the Supreme Court on the matter (Gazeta do Povo and Valor), and Edson Fachin denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Dino from the cases linked to him, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). 📺 Lula announced he will not attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, and on the afternoon of the same day Justice Estela Aranha, of the TSE, issued an injunction barring the broadcaster from showing his empty podium and from directing questions to the absent candidate, and sent the case to the TSE full court (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to a poll or to an act: it measures both sides with each one's timestamps.
